recipes.title: Mediterranean Greek Salad with Lemony Dressing
recipes.description: The quintessential Greek salad. Crisp cucumbers, ripe tomatoes, and salty feta cheese are tossed in a vibrant lemon and oregano vinaigrette. Refreshing and packed with nutrients.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the diced cucumber, tomatoes, red onion, and olives.
In a small jar, whisk together the olive oil, lemon juice, and oregano to create the dressing.
Pour the dressing over the vegetables and toss gently to coat.
Top with crumbled feta cheese and serve immediately while fresh and crisp.

recipes.title: Herb-Roasted Salmon with Asparagus
recipes.description: A perfect one-pan Mediterranean dinner. Heart-healthy salmon is roasted with tender asparagus and a bright lemon-herb rub.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place salmon fillets and asparagus on the sheet. Drizzle with a little olive oil.
Season with salt, pepper, and fresh dill. Place lemon slices on top of the salmon.
Bake for 12-15 minutes until salmon is flaky and asparagus is tender-crisp.

recipes.title: Authentic Chickpea Hummus
recipes.description: A smooth and creamy Mediterranean staple. High in plant-based protein and fiber, this homemade hummus is seasoned with garlic and tahini.
instructions: Place chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, and garlic in a food processor.
Process until smooth, adding a splash of water if needed to reach desired consistency.
Serve with raw vegetable sticks or whole wheat pita.
